name: Thunkable
description_en:
Thunkable builds mobile and web apps using AI assistance and editable app projects. Its public documentation describes visual screens and logic blocks, while current product pages also advertise a code editor and Discuss Mode. This profile keeps documented block-based operations distinct from untested behavior in the newer code-oriented interface.

A practical evaluation should cover request failures, saved project versions and the continuing subscription needed for the intended distribution path. Public projects can be previewed and remixed, and a private project’s recipient can make it public, so project sharing needs a deliberate decision.
description_zh:
Thunkable 通过 AI 辅助及可编辑项目构建移动和网页应用。公开文档描述可视化屏幕与逻辑积木，当前产品页还宣传代码编辑器及 Discuss Mode。本说明将有文档依据的积木操作，与较新代码界面尚未实测的行为分开。

实际评估应覆盖请求失败、项目版本保存及目标分发路径所需的持续订阅。公开项目可预览和再创作，私有项目接收者也可将其公开，因此需明确决定项目分享范围。

core_features.explanation_en: AI Edit Mode can insert blocks from a natural-language request in the documented visual builder.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在文档所示可视化构建器中，AI Edit Mode 可按自然语言请求插入积木。

core_features.explanation_en: Web API requests return response, status and error values for explicit handling.
core_features.explanation_zh: Web API 请求返回 response、status 和 error，供明确处理。

core_features.explanation_en: Versions can restore a drag-and-drop project or save a previous version as a new project.
core_features.explanation_zh: 版本可恢复拖放项目，或将旧版本另存为新项目。

en: Evaluate a small mobile form with a handled API failure.
Rehearse restoring a disposable visual project and inspect its privacy setting.
zh: 评估带 API 失败处理的小型移动表单。
演练恢复可丢弃可视化项目并核对隐私设置。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose the actual editor/project type and build a synthetic two-screen workflow.
steps.zh: 明确实际编辑器／项目类型，搭建模拟双屏流程。

steps.en: Test API errors, a saved version and project sharing; confirm live-app and subscription limits before release.
steps.zh: 测试 API 错误、保存版本及项目分享，发布前核对正式应用和订阅限制。

items.en: Version documentation is explicitly for drag-and-drop projects; coverage of external backends is unverified.
items.zh: 版本文档明确面向拖放项目，外部后端覆盖待核。

items.en: A private project’s recipient can make it public.
items.zh: 私有项目的接收者可将其公开。

pricing.summary_en: Free has bounded public projects/tokens. Builder shows $37/month equivalent billed yearly or $59 monthly; Advanced $99 yearly equivalent or $189 monthly. Accelerator’s $18/$19 billing labels are ambiguous in the read page, so no normalized rate is assigned. Ongoing live-app availability and legacy exceptions need account-specific confirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: Free 的公开项目及 token 有限。Builder 年付折合每月 $37 或月付 $59，Advanced 年付折合 $99 或月付 $189。已读页 Accelerator 的 $18／$19 周期标签有歧义，未标准化其价格。正式应用持续可用及旧方案例外需按账户核对。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Inspect generated logic in its actual editor
sections.title_zh: 在实际编辑器检查生成逻辑
sections.en: The AI Edit Mode guide describes inserting blocks through the Blocks tab and uses tokens. Current marketing additionally presents direct code editing. Verify which interface and project type a chosen workflow uses; a generated sign-in example does not prove authorization or error behavior is correct.
sections.zh: AI Edit Mode 指南描述通过 Blocks 页插入积木并消耗 token，当前营销又展示直接代码编辑。应核对目标流程实际使用哪种界面和项目类型，生成登录示例并不能证明授权或错误处理正确。

sections.title_en: Handle status and error before parsing
sections.title_zh: 解析前先处理状态与错误
sections.en: Web API blocks accept URL, parameters, headers and body, and return response/status/error. JSON responses need explicit object/list extraction. Test a successful result, a denied request and missing nested fields. The guide does not establish a server-side secret vault, so verify credential exposure rather than inferring it from API support.
sections.zh: Web API 积木接收 URL、参数、请求头和正文，并返回响应／状态／错误。JSON 需要明确提取对象及列表。应测试成功、拒绝请求和嵌套字段缺失，指南未证明存在服务端秘密保险库，不能从支持 API 推定凭据不会暴露。

sections.title_en: A saved version consumes project storage
sections.title_zh: 保存版本会消耗项目存储
sections.en: The drag-and-drop version guide describes automatic and manual versions, Restore and Save As. Saved versions are full project copies and count toward storage; downgrade can remove the oldest versions beyond the new limit. Restoring also restores project settings such as privacy. Confirm the project type and capacity before using it as a recovery method.
sections.zh: 拖放版本指南描述自动／手动版本、Restore 和 Save As。保存版本是完整项目副本并计入存储，降级可能删除超出新上限的最旧版本。恢复也会恢复项目隐私等设置，应先核对项目类型和容量，再将其用作恢复方法。

sections.title_en: Stop when server saves are not confirmed
sections.title_zh: 服务端保存未确认时应停止修改
sections.en: The FAQ describes locking editing after four consecutive unconfirmed changes to reduce further loss. It warns that poor connectivity can leave changes unpreserved. During evaluation, check reconnection and the last confirmed save using disposable work rather than assuming frequent autosave provides offline durability.
sections.zh: FAQ 描述在连续四次改动未获服务端保存确认后锁定编辑，以减少继续丢失，也提示网络不佳可能导致改动未保留。评估时应用可丢弃项目核对重连及最后确认保存，不能将频繁自动保存理解为离线持久性保证。

sections.title_en: Sharing can change publication of a project
sections.title_zh: 分享可能改变项目公开状态
sections.en: Public projects appear in the gallery for preview/remix. Pricing FAQ states that private projects can be shared with paid subscribers, who can share again or make them public. Decide whether a recipient may redistribute the project before granting access; private at creation does not guarantee it stays private after sharing.
sections.zh: 公开项目进入可预览／再创作的图库。价格 FAQ 说明私有项目可分享给付费订阅者，而接收者可再次分享或公开。授权前应明确接收者是否可再分发，创建时私有不保证分享后仍始终私有。

sections.en: Free has 2,000 AI tokens, three public projects and five screens per project. Builder lists one live published app and Advanced unlimited live apps. The FAQ makes ongoing availability dependent on subscription, with legacy-plan exceptions, and distinguishes expiring test downloads from distribution downloads. Confirm the current account’s exact continuity terms before launch.
sections.zh: Free 提供 2,000 AI token、三个公开项目及每项目五屏。Builder 列一个正式发布应用，Advanced 列不限正式应用。FAQ 将持续可用性与订阅联系，并列旧方案例外，还区分会过期的测试下载和分发下载。上线前需核对当前账户确切延续条款。
